case.title: Calm cancellation request
case.subject: Cancelling
case.text:
Hello, I'm retiring at the end of the year and closing my massage practice, so I'd like to cancel my Slotwise subscription. Thank you for the good service over the years. What happens to my client list?

George
case.why: Cancellation is self-serve; not angry, so no escalation. Reply should explain steps, export, and 30-day data retention.

output.reply:
Hello George,

Congratulations on your retirement, and thank you for being with us all these years.

To cancel, sign in as the account owner and go to Settings → Billing → Cancel subscription. There is no cancellation fee or notice period. Your account stays active until the end of the current billing period and you won't be charged again. Note that cancelling doesn't trigger a refund of the current period.

As for your client list: your data is kept for 30 days after the period ends, and you can reactivate within that time to restore everything. After 30 days it is permanently deleted. Before cancelling, we recommend exporting your clients and appointment history from Settings → Data → Export. You'll get an email with a download link (CSV files in a ZIP) within about 15 minutes, valid for 7 days.

Your booking link will stop working after the period ends, so let your clients know.

If you'd like your whole account deleted sooner, email us and our privacy team will handle it.

Slotwise Support
